Join millions of players worldwide. Adventure and perfect your strategy. Build and battle with your Clan in this epic real time multiplayer war game!
Mustachioed Barbarians, fire-wielding Wizards, and other unique troops await your command.

Clash of Clans is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Classic Features:
● Build and battle in real time: Customize your layout and level up each building to strengthen your defense in war.
● Assemble an army with countless combinations of spells, troops, and Heroes!

Multiplayer:
● Build a team and battle in Clan Wars against millions of active online players across the globe. Test your fighting skills in the competitive Clan War Leagues and prove your Clan is the best around!
● Collect resources and plunder loot from other players to upgrade your village. Use strategy and smarts to defend your Town Hall building in war!
● ﻿﻿Test your fighting skills in Ranked Mode and take part in competitive online multiplayer battles with players from around the world. Prove your dominance and rise all the way to Legend League.
● Keep your Clan Castle building safe and craft your defense strategy against enemy attacks. Build Towers, Cannons, Bombs, traps, Mortars, and walls to give you the edge in multiplayer battles.
● ﻿﻿Adventure with epic Heroes, like Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden, Royal Champion, Minion Prince, Dragon Duke, and Battle Machine.
● Use your Laboratory building to make your troops, spells, and Siege Machines even more powerful in war.
● Flex your strategy in real time: take part in free online multiplayer games. Battle through Friendly Challenges, Friendly Wars, and special live multiplayer war game events.

Single Player:
● Start fighting against the Goblin King in a single-player campaign mode and become a hero of the realm.
● ﻿﻿Learn new strategy tactics and experiment with army combinations and Clan Castle troops in Practice Mode.

Builder Base:
● Adventure to the mysterious shores of Builder Base and discover new buildings, characters, and a whole new way to play.
● Turn your Builder Base into an unbeatable fortress. Build up your defenses and perfect your fighting strategy. Conquer rival players in real time in the online multiplayer Versus Battle war game mode.

What are you waiting for, Chief? Get ready to conquer! Join the adventure today.

A network connection is also required.

If you have fun playing Clash of Clans, you may also enjoy other free multiplayer Supercell games like Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, Boom Beach, and Hay Day. Make sure to check those out!

Support: Chief, are you having problems? Visit https://help.supercellsupport.com/clash-of-clans/en/index.html or contact us in-game by going to Settings > Help and Support.
